description: The file defines a class 'Coupon' within the 'Opencart.Admin.Model.Marketing' namespace. It contains methods for managing coupons, including creating, updating, deleting, and retrieving coupons, as well as managing associated products, categories, and histories. The class interacts with a database via an inherited engine Model class.

classes.name: Coupon
classes.description: Represents the data access layer for managing marketing coupons in the OpenCart admin model. Provides CRUD operations and relations handling for coupons, products, categories, and histories.

methods.name: addCoupon
methods.description: Inserts a new coupon record into the database with data provided in an associative array. Also associates the coupon with products and categories if specified.

methods.name: editCoupon
methods.description: Updates an existing coupon record identified by coupon_id with new data, and manages associated products and categories.

methods.name: deleteCoupon
methods.description: Deletes a coupon and its related products, categories, and histories from the database.

methods.name: getCoupon
methods.description: Retrieves a coupon record by its coupon_id.

methods.name: getCouponByCode
methods.description: Fetches a coupon record based on its unique code.

methods.name: getCoupons
methods.description: Returns a list of coupons with optional sorting, ordering, and pagination.

methods.name: getTotalCoupons
methods.description: Returns the total number of coupons in the database.

methods.name: getHistories
methods.description: Retrieves coupon usage histories with pagination.

methods.name: deleteHistories
methods.description: Deletes all history entries related to a specific coupon.

methods.name: getTotalHistories
methods.description: Returns the total count of history entries for a specific coupon.

methods.name: addProduct
methods.description: Associates a product with a coupon.

methods.name: deleteProducts
methods.description: Removes all product associations for a given coupon.

methods.name: deleteProductsByProductId
methods.description: Deletes product associations by product ID across all coupons.

methods.name: getProducts
methods.description: Gets all product IDs associated with a specific coupon.

methods.name: addCategory
methods.description: Associates a category with a coupon.

methods.name: deleteCategories
methods.description: Removes all category associations for a given coupon.

methods.name: deleteCategoriesByCategoryId
methods.description: Deletes category associations by category ID across coupons.

methods.name: getCategories
methods.description: Fetches all category IDs associated with a specific coupon.

methods.name: getTotalHistories
methods.description: Retrieves the total number of history entries for a specific coupon.
